newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: S.Korean cabinet passes 1997 state budget draft.
newsitem.headline: S.Korean cabinet passes 1997 state budget draft.

text.p: South Korea's cabinet council on Tuesday approved the Finance and Economy Ministry's draft for a 67.78 trillion won balanced state budget for 1997, the Prime Minister's Office said.
The amount represents a 12.8 percent increase from this year's 60.11 trillion won, a finance ministry official said.
When special accounts are included, the overall budget scale will amount to 71.6 trillion won, up 13.7 percent from this year's 62.96 trillion won, he said.
The draft will be sent to the National Assembly early next month for approval sometime in early December, he said.
